facts.fact: KICTANet, with Meedan, ran a year-long study of over a thousand Swahili-language content items, finding over half involved gendered targeting and about one in eight involved doxxing, per the KICTANet-sourced article.
The KenSafeSpace coalition, with KICTANet as co-applicant, produced seven research outputs including the Voices at Risk report on harmful speech incidents across Facebook, X and TikTok.
